newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Storage Tech Q2 seen positive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Storage Tech Q2 seen positive.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group analyst Gary Helmig said it is likely that Storage Technology Corp will have a strong second quarter and could exceed Wall Street earnings estimates of $0.82 a share.
-- said "Storage Tech is probably going to have a very good quarter."

-- expects Storage Tech to post "more tape revenues, which means more tape profits." In April, Storage Tech said it expected its mainframe tape revenues to improve in the fiscal second quarter ending June 30.
-- said maintains Storage Tech as a short-term buy, long-term hold.
-- said has a $50 short-term price target. The time frame for the target was not immediately available.
-- said Storage Tech's gross margin were up in the March quarter and said "there is nothing that suggests that gross margins would go down this quarter."
-- said Storage Tech is in "a very enviable cash position."
-- said Storage Tech has some longer-term issues to address.
